name: findchildcare
description: Find daycares, home childcare and before/after-school programs listed across Canada, by city, province or postal code, with ages served, licensing, CWELCC or subsidy, languages and current openings. Childcare providers can ask how to list their service.

interface.longDescription:
Find daycares, home childcare and before/after-school programs listed across Canada.

Ask for childcare in a city, a province or near a postal code. Narrow by your child's age, licensed care, CWELCC or subsidy, a language spoken in care, or providers with an opening right now. Each result shows the ages served, licensing and current openings, with a link to the provider's page on FindChildcare.ca, where you can send an inquiry or join a waitlist.

Where nothing is listed yet, it tells you so and names the nearby cities that do have listings.

Childcare providers can ask how to list their service and post openings.

No account needed. Covers Canada only.
